description: This PHP source file is responsible for handling the saving of MailScanner folder configurations within the vtiger CRM system. It processes request parameters to determine which folders should be enabled for scanning and interacts with associated classes to update the configuration.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates information and operations related to MailScanner configuration.

methods.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo::__construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MailScanner info object with a specific scanner name.

methods.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo::enableFoldersForScan
methods.description: Enables specified folders for mail scanning based on provided folder information.
